content.value: Describe the working principle of governing system for an <sub>Impulse</sub> turbine.
<sup>4(a)</sup> Show that in a pelton wheel maximum efficiency is possible, if the jet <sub>velocity</sub> is 15 twice the bucket velocity.

<sup>4(b)</sup> A pelton wheel develops 5520 kW under a head of 240 mat an overall <sub>efficiency</sub> of 80% when revolving at a speed of 200 rpm. Find the unit <sub>discharge,</sub> unit <sub>power</sub> and unit speed. If the head on the same turbine fall during the summer season to 150 m, find the discharge, power and speed for this head.
<sup>5(a)</sup> What are the conditions that required to form a doublet? Deduce the <sub>expressions</sub> <sub>18</sub> for stream function and velocity potential for a doublet.
